harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 as a persistent host firewall: public zone permanently allows only the ssh service and TCP 8080, with the zone target set to REJECT so all other inbound traffic is actively rejected. firewalld is active and enabled (persists across boots). Verified allow/reject behavior before and after a full node reboot, confirming persistence.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: firewalld already active/enabled; public zone allowed cockpit, dhcpv6-client, ssh but no 8080 rule and default target
Started a test HTTP listener on 0.0.0.0:8080 as connectivity evidence
Removed unrelated permanent service exceptions (cockpit, dhcpv6-client) from the public zone
Added permanent ssh service and 8080/tcp port to the public zone
Set the public zone's permanent target to REJECT and reloaded firewalld
Verified ssh(22) and 8080 reachable while an arbitrary unrelated port (12345) is connection-refused
Confirmed firewalld is systemctl-enabled for persistence
Captured pre-reboot boot_id, then rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed boot_id changed (31b01b46... -> 789939d2...)
Post-reboot: verified firewalld active/enabled/running with identical persisted rules (ssh, 8080/tcp, target REJECT)
Restarted the test HTTP listener and re-verified ssh/8080 reachable and port 12345 rejected post-recovery

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound
evidence.summary: firewalld permanent config in public zone set to services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp, target %%REJECT%%; curl to 8080 returns 200, /dev/tcp to 22 opens, /dev/tcp to unrelated port 12345 gets connection refused

evidence.requirement: Firewall enabled for persistence at boot

evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 31b01b46-96de-4ded-a021-49887e7d4053, firewalld active/enabled with final ruleset, and working curl to 8080

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent execs failed (connection reset/timeout) then succeeded again with new boot_id 789939d2-fc51-49d3-bd14-79265768281f, proving the restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of firewall and service state
evidence.summary: firewalld active/enabled/running post-reboot with identical persisted rules (ssh, 8080/tcp, REJECT target); curl to 8080 succeeds, ssh port open, unrelated port 12345 refused
